Hi, our fashion e-commerce brand has been running paid media campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok for the past several months, and performance has been declining sharply. Our media team has exported the current account setup, bidding configurations, daily spend/conversion data, and some notes on past A/B tests we ran. All files are in the `/workspace/accounts/meta/campaigns/` folder.

We need a comprehensive audit report that covers everything: whether our account structure is clean and healthy, whether our bidding and budget setup is actually efficient, a proper blueprint for the next A/B test we should run (our last two tests were declared winners too early and we don't trust the results), and a clear set of live monitoring rules so we can catch problems before they spiral.

Please produce a single file called `campaign_audit_report.json` that covers all of this. Our head of media needs it to make budget decisions this week.
